decisions.action: POWO/WCVP accepts the species at species rank; existing canonical name is correct, no new card or rename.
Original 1810 combination, preserve as search alias not an additional learner taxon.
Historical generic combination of the same nomenclatural type.
POWO synonymizes S. asper with S. compositus; 2006 World Grass Species treatment cited S. asper as an alternative. Retain historic source concept rather than auto-certifying specimens.

decisions.source_name: Sporobolus compositus var. drummondii (Trin.) Kartesz & Gandhi
decisions.accepted_name: Sporobolus compositus (Poir.) Merr. under POWO; variety accepted in ITIS/NatureServe
decisions.action: POWO lists var. drummondii as heterotypic synonym of species; ITIS and NatureServe accept it at variety rank. Preserve Bob Harms photographer's source-variety label without treating it as POWO-accepted variety or claiming voucher confirmation.

decisions.source_name: Sporobolus drummondii (Trin.) Vasey and Sporobolus attenuatus Nash
decisions.accepted_name: Sporobolus compositus (Poir.) Merr. under POWO; var. drummondii under ITIS
decisions.action: POWO lists both under S. compositus; ITIS maps them to S. compositus var. drummondii. No separate species cards; retain rank provenance.

decisions.source_name: Sporobolus compositus var. macer (Trin.) Kartesz & Gandhi
decisions.accepted_name: UNRESOLVED at POWO in this review; ITIS accepts this variety under S. compositus
decisions.rank: variety accepted in ITIS/NatureServe; POWO species page does not enumerate macer
decisions.action: ITIS, NatureServe and USFS recognize var. macer; POWO S. compositus synonym list reviewed today does not list macer, so no unsupported assertion about POWO synonymy or acceptance. Keep existing source-variety attribution; do not infer variety from rhizome image for other specimens.

decisions.source_name: Sporobolus macer (Trin.) Hitchc. and Sporobolus asper var. macer (Trin.) Shinners
decisions.accepted_name: Sporobolus compositus var. macer (Trin.) Kartesz & Gandhi according to ITIS
decisions.action: ITIS maps both historical names to var. macer; POWO name-level mapping not independently resolved here. Preserve source attribution and unresolved global treatment.
POWO/WCVP separately accepts rough dropseed; do not collapse its existing learner card into S. compositus.

decisions.source_name: Sporobolus compositus var. clandestinus (Biehler) Wipff & S.D.Jones
decisions.rank: homotypic synonym of separately accepted species
decisions.action: Historical compositus variety is mapped by POWO to S. clandestinus, not S. compositus. Avoid misrouting old records by epithet alone.

decisions.source_name: Source-labelled var. drummondii and var. macer photographs and other learner images
decisions.action: Taxonomy names do not verify individual photographed plants or source-variety determinations. Existing photo records remain unchanged; no image, morphology, lesson, or arrow edit.

decisions.source_name: Hybrid origin or hybrid parentage of S. compositus complex
decisions.action: No hybrid parentage or hybrid identity inferred from accepted names, morphology, or photos. Existing holds preserved.

source_notes.POWO_WCVP: 2026-10-24 live POWO accepted-name/synonym checks. Species page lists 23 synonyms including var. drummondii, but no macer in that displayed list; omission is not proof of rejection.
source_notes.ITIS: ITIS species and varieties records checked 2026-10-24; older underlying taxonomy source dates are displayed and may differ from Kew current circumscription.
source_notes.NatureServe: NatureServe current species taxonomic comments explicitly recognize three varieties and separate S. clandestinus.
source_notes.USFS: USFS Fire Effects Information System recognizes three varieties; secondary synthesis of published taxonomy.
source_notes.historical_primary: Engstrom 2004 New England Plant Conservation Plan cites Riggins 1977 taxonomic treatment; Riggins original monograph not directly inspected, so do not claim primary monograph independently verified.
source_notes.hold_boundary: Photographer-identified variety labels are provenance, not independently confirmed vouchers or proof of accepted rank in POWO.
